title: Issue-guided safe ReadProperty analogue
purpose: Exercise confirmed property-read handling and ACK construction paths related to the reported closing-tag reservation issue while requesting a simple property in a compact valid form.
expected_behavior: Target parses a Confirmed-Request-PDU for ReadProperty and returns either a valid ComplexACK-PDU with the property value or a protocol-level error for an unsupported object/property combination.
constraints_preserved: BVLC total length 0x0011 matches message size
APDU uses confirmed service choice 0x0c for ReadProperty
Object identifier and property identifier fields kept short and internally consistent
No malformed closing-tag construction is injected in the request
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue only; it does not reproduce any exact crash payload or malformed ACK-size trigger.
